Ideally situated on Cathedral Street Dublin 1, this attractive one- bedroom, one- bathroom apartment offers comfortable city- centre living in a highly convenient location.

The property is surrounded by a wide variety of cafes, restaurants, pubs, and everyday amenities, with everything you need close at hand. its central position makes it an excellent choice for , students or anyone looking to enjoy the convenience of living and working in Dublin city centre. 

The apartment comprises an inviting entrance way with a hot press, a generous open plan living room/kitchen fitted with a modern kitchen and plumbing for a washing machine, One spacious double bedroom, and a bathroom with WC and wash hand basin.
